name: MGS Seguros
verdict: MGS, Seguros y Reaseguros, S.A., a Spanish insurance company founded in 1907 as Mutua General de Seguros; no state stake found. Nothing found.
note: Proposed none 2026-09-28 (PR #340): a private sociedad anónima (Estatutos, March 2025); no state body or fund found anywhere in the chain, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against it was found, so nothing found.
